def.label: 105 mm cannon
def.note: Cut C's numbers around doc 16's one fixed figure, the 1,000 ms cycle floor (W14). 300,000 cm is 3 km, which is longer than the 2.56 km arena's diagonal is wide, so range is never the thing that ends an engagement on this map; the inner band at 1.5 km is where the dispersion halves. 100,000 cm/s is 1 km/s, so a shot across the whole arena is in flight for about 2.5 s and the target really can leave the predicted cell. 6,000 ms is twelve Engaged pulses between rounds.
